meta.name: n8n-error-handling
meta.description: Implement error handling, retries, and monitoring in n8n workflows. Use when the user asks about n8n error handling, retry logic, dead letter queues, circuit breakers, workflow failures, error workflows, or making n8n workflows production-ready. Triggers on "n8n error", "retry", "dead letter", "circuit breaker", "workflow failed", "error handling", "continue on fail", "retry on fail". Do NOT use for general workflow design.

copy.tagline: 让 n8n 工作流具备重试、死信队列和熔断机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 n8n 搭建自动化流程，需要确保工作失败时能自动恢复
copy.tagline_en: Add retries, dead letter queues, and circuit breakers to n8n workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build n8n workflows and need to handle failures gracefully

howto.what: Claude 会指导你为 n8n 工作流配置错误处理、重试和监控，包括设置节点重试、错误分支、工作流错误处理和死信队列，使工作流更健壮。
howto.when: 当用户询问 n8n 错误处理、重试、死信队列等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的 n8n 工作流 API 调用总失败，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议添加重试和错误分支。
Claude 会指导记录失败项并重新处理。

say.text: n8n 工作流怎么配置错误告警？
say.note: Claude 会建议设置错误工作流发送通知。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you to configure error handling, retries, and monitoring for n8n workflows, including node-level retries, error branches, workflow-level error handling, and dead letter queues.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about n8n error handling, retry logic, dead letter queues, etc.

say_en.text: My n8n workflow keeps failing on API calls, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest adding retries and error branches.

say_en.text: How do I set up a dead letter queue?
say_en.note: Claude will guide logging failed items and reprocessing.

say_en.text: How to configure error alerts for n8n?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend setting up an error workflow for notifications.
